name: Tank Titan
author: MUmerAli
description:
Ever felt the need to just blow up stuff… Why not blow up tanks with other tanks! Total destruction of the environment as well as an objective to save a little bird.

In this game you will have the chance to not only become a saviour. In this adventure filled game you go around with a tank trying to blow up other tanks! Oh did we mention there is also lots of environmental destruction! 

During this game you will find yourself in a Tank shooter adventure, the main goal is to destroy other tanks even if it means destroying the level walls. 
Will you be able to save the bird or will the tanks get the best of you?
